en: Alright, Cesar<FG> Do your thing<FG>
Hm. My pleasure.\nPray, heed your kinsman, Lord of Light,\nAnd make the pathway plain to sight<FG>
A teleportal appears<FG>
Urgh... Climbing all those stairs has made me really hungry... Can we have something to eat before we head to Ingenia<FH>
Right, time to get back to work<FG> We're off to the Tomb of the Sun. Cesar, if you'd care to tell us the way<FH>
Of course. The entrance to the Tomb lies in the corner of a plateau at the heart of the Grand Dunes.
The easiest way to find it is to travel south from the border with the Lumberlands.
That sounds simple enough<FG> Let's go<FG>
The High King must be loving this. Let's get that barrier down so I can go wipe the smile off his face...
Well, this is the top of the plateau... I don't see much but cactuses, though...
Hm. Did you really think the secrets of the Dunisian royal family could so easily be found<FH> Watch and learn...
Pray, heed your kinsman, Lord of Light,\nAnd make the pathway plain to sight<FG>
A teleportal appears<FG>
Giddy-up, pardner<FG> Time to mosey on down to Ingenia, save the city, an' see what the Queen can tell us about breakin' down barriers<FG>
Ingenia was where we first met, wasn't it<FH> So much has happened since then. It feels like a lifetime ago...
Well<FH> What are you waiting for<FH> Go and get me that Trinity Stone from Dunisia<FG> Didn't you say you were in a hurry<FH>
Now then, are you ready for this trial or what<FH>
Good<FG> Off you pop, then<FG>
Well hurry up, will you<FH> But don't go thinking you'll pass if you're not properly prepared<MV>this one's not for the faint-hearted<FG>
What are you hanging around here for<FH> I thought you were in a hurry<FG> Get lost<FG>
Did you manage to pass the time pleasantly<FH> The party will be starting soon.
Good<FG> Then let's celebrate our hard-won peace<FG> It's time to have some fun for once<FG>
I see. Well, finish whatever it is you need to do, and then let's celebrate<FG>
If we help her take back her city, the Queen will surely reward us. Perhaps she'll finally give me some of those baubles she promised<FG>
So the Queen of Ingenia's a master magician, is she<FH> I'm going to have to bend her ear a little when this is all over...
I've never heard of a stone that can teach you spells before... Do you think the Lapis Leveli might be Her Majesty's own invention<FH>
Well, look at that<MV>perfect timing<FG> With this lot to help us, we're sure to be able to take back Accordia.
Huh<FH> But how did they know to come here<FH>
Because I ordered them to. They're still loyal, and we're not leaving them out of the fight to take back their home.
When you're ready, talk to the soldiers at the city gates in No Man's Land. Our only chance to take back the capital is to attack en masse<FG>
Hey, Cesar<MV>it's strange that Unos's heirloom was left in Dunisia, eh<FH>
Not to me. We members of the royal family know that Unos's connection with our realm was a strong one.
He spent the final days of his life there, before finally succumbing to the wounds he sustained in the War of Kings.
On his deathbed, he ordered my ancestor<MV>Dunis<MV>to seal his power away in the Tomb of the Sun, and to watch over it for all time.
Hm. I had always thought it little more than a fairy tale, but the Heart of Brightness is proof that the legends were true.
Well, I've never heard that story before. So Unos was a fan of our hometown, was he<FH> That makes me quite proud<FG>
This hardly seems the time for a detour...but if the exquisite Queen of Ingenia requires my services, how could I possibly refuse<FH>
To ascend and descend Pinnacle of Peace each day would make for superlative training of legs. I shall endeavour to do just this<FG>
Phew... It is supremely relieving to place feet upon solid ground once more...
Let's head back to the top of the Pinnacle of Peace and use The Great Leveller to bring down that barrier<FG>
As soon as Healix has used that spell to bring down the barrier, we can go and give the High King and his brother a piece of our minds<FG>
We may have found the Heart of Brightness, but that doesn't mean this is going to be easy. We should make sure we're fully prepared.
Yes, Boss<FG> Still, the fact that it was right where we thought it would be made things a lot easier, eh<FH>
Yeah. Do you think Unos knew we'd come looking for it one day<FH>
I think he must have suspected it, at least. That someone in the distant future might corrupt the Cup of Kings again... (sigh)
Ngggh...<FG> Nnngggh...<FG> Must...focus...<FG>\nAlright, that's enough practise<MV>I'm ready to goo<FG>
We must not keep Their Radiances waiting. To the Pinnacle of Peace, at the double<FG>
If we can bring down that barrier, our way to His Radiance's throne room will be clear. It's time to end this.
So there's spells only monsters can use now, are there<FH> Sure, an' I hadn't the foggiest such things existed<FG>
We're going to have to climb that stupid tower again, aren't we<FH> Ugh, this is so unfair...
So, time to hit the Pinnacle of Peace and find out what King Creep an' his bro are up to, huh<FH>
They'll be in the throne room at the top. It's the hardest part to reach, and the best protected.
Alriiight<FG> Let's strike while the iron's hot, then<FG> We've got a tower to climb<FG>
Hm. Rushing in blindly as ever, I see. Do you not think we might want to face such a foe prepared<FH>
He's right. Let's take some time to get ready first. We'll meet at the end of the square by the doors to the Pinnacle.
Woohoo<FG> Healix is going to save the day<FG> And I'm going to be right beside him, cheering him on<FG> Ao-aooo<FG>
That Dhuran guy was pretty tough. Can't wait for the rematch...
We're comin' to get ya, Your Shadiness<FG> We're gonna pay you back for what you put our pals through<MV>with interest<FG>
Thank goodness<FG> We have a way to break down that barrier at last<FG> Come, we must go there right away<FG>
Well, it wasn't easy, but seeing all these smiling faces makes me glad we managed to take back the town.
Yeah... I only wish I knew why the High King filled it with monsters in the first place. Why would he put everyone in danger like that<FH>
Well, that's what we're going to the Pinnacle of Peace to find out, right<FH>
You're right. We'll find the High King and get him to tell us everything<MV>and then we'll finally put a stop to this madness<FG>
Her Majesty might act like an ice queen, but deep down inside, she's an absolute angel<FG>
How old would you say our friend the Queen is<FH> Actually<MV>don't answer that. It's rude to speculate about a lady's age, after all.
Come, let us ascend to pinnacle of Pinnacle<FG> This time, twinned kings shall not escape our clutchings<FG>
Hm. You two seem a lot more certain of your purpose than you did...
The prophecy thing, you mean<FH> Pah<FG> I don't care<FG> Sovereign twins or not, what they're doing is wrong, and we're going to stop it<FG>
He's right<FG> It doesn't matter what the prophecy says<MV>no king has the right to harm his own people<FG>
I am glad to see that you have both come around at last. Then it's time to climb the Pinnacle and put an end to this sorry farce.
The problem is, it's not exactly safe. Especially now that no one uses it any more...
Eurgh... This sounds like a terrible plan<FG> Do we have to<FH>
For Tsarevna, I would swim deepest ocean, brave burning building...even c-c-climb to t-t-top of t-t-tallest t-t-tower... (shiver)
Oh, hello<FG> I was hoping you'd pop by<MV>I've got something for you that I think you might like. Here<FG>
<F4><I0>01 receives a map to the Magic Maze<FG>
<F4><I0>01 receives a map to the Domain of the Dead<FG>
<F4><I0>01 receives maps to the Den of the Defenders and Evolution's Lair<FG>
Desdemona...are you alright<FH> It can't be easy going to see the High King again after he betrayed your trust like that...
Don't feel that you have to force yourself. If you'd prefer to keep your distance, we can go to the Pinnacle by ours<MV>
Ha<FG> I'm made of sterner stuff than that, you know<FG> And besides, we have more important things to worry about<MV>like the Cup of Kings.
If it really is cursed, then how are we going to fix it<FH> There's no one with Unos's power left in the world...
Which I suppose means it's time to stop thinking and start acting. Come on<MV>let's get in there<FG>
As a reward for passing my trial, I shall bestow upon you a power greater than any other. Now, close your eyes...
The party learn the ‘Kazapple’ party power<FG>
Sir<FG> I've finished my three hundred sit-ups, sir<FG> What's next, sir<FH>
Good work, private<FG> You're finally starting to show some promise<FG> Now, your next<MV>
Ha. Healix is still playing the drill sergeant at a time like this. And it looks like Ruff is still keeping up with him too...
I just hope they don't tire themselves out before we head to the Pinnacle... Looks like they've got energy to spare, though...
It's good to finally be back in Accordia doin' wot I do best. An' it's all fanks to you<FG>
The attack was absolutely terrifying. I'm glad to be back home now it's all over.
Look who's back in business, baby<FG> An' it's all thanks to you, kiddo<FG>
Well...maybe. But there's nothing we can do about that now. Let's just concentrate on getting ready to go to the Beastlands...
How's the preparation coming<FH> You'll need to be ready for even more danger than usual out in the Beastlands.
...What's that<FH> Which way did he go<FH> Off over that way, I think.
The conditions may not be great for humans up there, but they're perfect for monsters.
But if it's so inhospitable, what would this seer be doing living there<FH>
Hard to say. For all we know, he could have been lying. Or maybe he's just a little...eccentric.
He might even be a monster himself... Or...
Welcome to Accordia, home of His Radiance the High King, Supreme Sovereign of the Seven Realms<FG> I'm so lucky to live here<FG>
The king of the whole world lives at the top of this tremendous tower. I'll bet the view is beautiful from up there...
I really want to strike up a conversation with that girl at the bottom of the stairs, but I don't know what to say...
Isn't the weather beautiful<FH> Walking through the city on a day like today makes me want to break out into song<FG>
The Pinnacle of Peace is a remarkable structure. And the king who lives atop it is equally remarkable<FG>
It's so strange... If I'm in a bad mood, I can just come here and stare out over the city and all my worries melt away...
Who do you suppose built the Pinnacle of Peace<FH> And however did they go about it<FH> Every time I see it I wonder about that...
Ho ho ho<FG> Ahhh, life is good<FG> All I do is spend my days sunning myself and chatting with my friends<FG>
Meow<FG> Meow<FG>\nPurrrrrr...
Neigh<FG>
There are so many wonderful shops in Accordia<FG> I always promise myself I won't buy too much, but things never quite go to plan<FG>
Cor, it ain't 'alf 'ard work lookin' after these flowers... Wot<FH> You fink it's weird someone like me doin' a bit o' gardenin'<FH> Grow up<FG>
Hee hee hee<FG> (slurp) I've never been anywhere bigger than Harba before. This is gooing to be so much fun<FG>
Jaypers<FG> Would ye look at all the gear they're floggin' here<FH> Yer friend wasn't wrong<MV>this is the place fer me<FG>
I can't believe we're actually going to get to meet the High King... Alriiight<FG> We're going up in the world<FG>
It's almost time to meet with the High King. Just...try not to embarrass us, will you<FH>
Monster numbers within the city are reported to be unlike anything we've seen before. Please ensure that you are fully prepared<FG>
Are you sure you wish to enter<FH>
Understood. We will stand guard here until you are ready.
NOT USED
NOT USED
And where do you think you're going<FH> We should be sure to talk with everyone first. We must be certain of our next move.
We can't take back Accordia yet<MV>we need to find the Heart of Brightness and dispel the Cover of Darkness.
We may have found the Heart of Brightness, but the battle to retake the city won't be easy. We must make our preparations first.
We can't just go charging into Accordia by ourselves. We should join up with the soldiers gathering at the No Man's Land gate.
NOT USED
Well, I hate to say it, but I'm stuck. I don't even know where to begin looking for a way to get up to the Black Manse...
There's no response. It's just a corpse.
NOT USED
NOT USED
Eek<FG> Somebody help meee<FG>
I'm alive...and it's all thanks to you<FG> You have my eternal gratitude<FG>
NOT USED
Remember, we're looking for a float-o-copier that likes to play tricks in Harba. Why don't we go and see if we can find him<FH>
The Dunisian army may be plotting their next move as we speak. As soon as you're ready, let's head through the desert to Dunisia.
The first rule of adventurin' is ‘be prepared’. Make sure ye've everythin' ye need before settin' off, or ye'll be sorry<FG>
So, we're heading to Dunisia, are we<FH> I didn't think I'd be going back so soon...
So, we're heading back to Dunisia, are we<FH> This is hardly the happy homecoming I was hoping for...
So we're gooing to the desert, are we<FH> Ulp... I'm not oozed to the heat. I hope I don't melt... (shudder)
...I, I mean<MV>the scorching sun means nothing to a goorizzled veteran like me<FG> Whatever the weather, I shall prevail<FG>
Hmm... I sense a new power within you. It seems your training is proceeding well.
If you seek yet greater strength, you must test yourself against yet mightier monsters.
Bring all your skill, power and knowledge to bear in order to dispatch them swiftly and decisively, and you will surely be rewarded.
That's the spirit<FG> But remember, we're about to step into the heart of the Black Manse. Once we're there, we're there until this is over...
Heh<FG> When it comes to wood, I'm pretty good<FG> C'mon, let's go see what's on the other side<FG>
The path's completely blocked. I suppose we'll just have to find another way around...
Oh, I don't know<MV>those branches are so dry and dusty, they look like they'd burn away in no time. Let's give it a try, shall we<FH>
Hiii-yah<FG>
Maribel's spell burns the dry branches clean away<FG>
Wow, that was amazing<FG> What a blaze<FG>
Tee hee<FG> Told you<FG> If it wasn't for me, you'd never have got past them<FG> You can thank me later<FG>
Hmm... We'll have to look for another way round. We're never going to get past that whirlwind in one piece...
It does look dangerous...but there may be another way. Perhaps I can use magic to dispel it...
Can you feel that<FH> Pure darkness... The air is thick with it...
Meena casts Woosh, and sends the whirlwind whizzing away<FG>
Brilliant, Meena<FG> I would never have thought of fighting wind with wind<FG> Thank you so much<FG>
Please, it was nothing. I'm happy to help in whatever way I can. Come, let us continue onwards<FG>
The Dunisian army may already be preparing to renew their assault on Harba. We have to get down there and stop them<FG>
In the tradin' game, it ain't just what ye know, but who ye know<FG> Small wonder yer man there was happy as Larry to get his client list back<FG>
It took some doing, but we've finally got the documents we need to enter Dunisia. Let's hope the guards let us through this time.
It took some doing, but the writ of passage is ours at last<FG> Come on, let's head to Dunisia<FG>
Gooray<FG> Now the guards will let us into Dunisia<FG> I can't wait to see where you and <F4><I0>11 goorew up<FG>
UNUSED
You can allocate skill points by selecting ‘Skills’ from the main menu, then ‘Allocate Skill Points’.
I'm going to rest up here a little while longer and then head to Accordia. Be careful out there, won't you<FH>
Where do you think you're going<FH> You can't just go sauntering back to Harba<FG>
The longer we delay, the greater the risk that Dunisia will strike again. We've got to go and speak to the High King as soon as possible.
We need to get to Accordia. Now<FG>
Ha, not too shabby<FG> You've been keeping yourself busy this last year, I see<FG>
And it looks like you've actually been doing your homework for once<FG> Shall we step things up a gear<FH>
I thought you'd never ask<FG> Alriiight<FG> Time to take the gloves off and get serious<FG>
What an unusual door<FG> I can't see any way of opening it, though...
Hmm... What is this strange fan for...<FH> Ah<FG> Perhaps that is how it opens<FG>
My apologies, but owing to the highly unstable situation in the Beastlands, the river crossing is closed until further notice.
Would you like to go to the other side<FH>
You two really are close to the Prince, aren't you<FH> ...Which gives me an idea.
Your Majesty, perhaps it would be safest to send these two in first. It may help to show Prince Cesar that we mean him no harm.
Hmm... A sound suggestion, Lady Desdemona. My sudden appearance may only serve to agitate him further.
Apologies, my young friends, but would you do me this last favour<FH> I believe it would go a long way toward paving the road to peace.
Speaking of which, we'd better head back to Accordia. The High King will want to get to the bottom of this as soon as possible.
Stop<FG> STOP<FG> Someone's gooing to get hurt if you carry on like that<FG>
Let me try something...
NOT USED
Do we really have to go back to that horrid desert<FH> My clothes are covered in sand already<FG>
Wooow<FG> I've never seen a healslime wearing a hat before<FG> He looks sooo cool<FG>
<F4><I0>41 examines the chest...but it's empty...
...except for a button hidden at the bottom<FG> Press the button<FH>
Are you really sure you don't want to press the button<FH>
Let us make our preparations quickly. I need to know what excuses the Queen of Ingenia may have to offer us in her defence...
Ingenia is to the east, on the other side of the Lumberlands. As soon as you're ready, let's head out.
I felt so awful fighting Cesar back in Dunisia. I'm so glad we won him round<MV>it's great having the gang back together again<FG>
I wasn't sure how things would turn out back there in Dunisia. Still, Cesar's onside now<MV>all's well that ends well, eh<FH>
Hee hee hee<FG> (slurp) Ruff's my new best frie<MV> I mean, he's the finest cadet in my slooper-dooper Knight School<FG>
That Ruff lad's full o' craic, ain't he<FH> Reminds me o' me own little lad. Aww, Tipper... What're ye doin' right now, I wonder...
So, that prince is an old friend of yours, is he<FH> I've got a friend who's a prince<MV>and he's a proper pain in the neck too<FG>
Healix is so much fun<FG> We're gonna be best friends forever<FG>
I will return to Harba and await further news. Go safely, now.
If you are going to Ingenia, take the eastern road.
We'll have to find that ghost's friend if we want them to make the bridge appear.
Wow, really<FH> That sounds like it'd be amaaa<MV> Wait, you don't mean...<FG>
Of course<FG> The Queen of Ingenia's probably the only one who could have got that feather AND made herself look like the King of Harba<FG>
Hm. So my father's murderer was the Sorceress Queen<FH> She will pay for this...
Now, now, Your Highness. It is merely a theory as yet.
But it's also the only clue we have.
Which is why the High King has asked us to go and investigate<MV>discreetly, of course.
Let me come with you. If there are clues to the identity of my father's murderer there, I must see them with my own eyes.
I had a feeling you'd say that. Well, who am I to refuse<FH>
Do not forget that you are a king now, my young friend.
The fate of thousands now rests on your every word and deed. Take care.
...I will, Your Majesty.
We'd better get going. The sooner we get there, the less likely the Ingenians are to find out what we're up to.
Cesar joins the party<FG>
Yes we do<FG> We have to get to Ingenia<FG> Desdemona<MV>how do we get to this graveyard<FH>
We need to head back to the west and then south. The road leads on through the cemetery and into the Wildwood from there.
Alriiight<FG> The long, scary, dangerous way round awaits<FG> Let's get going<FG>
Before we set off, I'd better explain a little about the road to Ingenia.
Who would have thought that our first meeting in four years would be on the battlefield<FH>
And who would have thought that you would beat me<FH> I had expected the same overenthusiastic children as always.
Ha, we'll take that as a compliment, Your Princeliness<FG>
Or what<FH>
...No, it's nothing. I was just thinking of something similar that happened a while back<MV>never mind.
You lot are being charming to one another as ever, I see<FG>
By the way, I haven't asked how you three became friends in the first place...
Oh, we all went to the Academy together. Cesar was a bit older, but he seemed to like playing with us more than kids his own age.
Hm<FG> I could hardly leave you to your own devices. Goddess knows what kind of trouble you would have got yourselves into.
Pah, you were always the one getting yourself into trouble<FG> If we hadn't been there to get you out of hot water, you'd have<MV>
Oh, stop it you two<FG> I know you've got four years' worth of bickering to catch up on, but do you have to do it all at once<FG><FH>
Ha ha<FG> No one can push your buttons like your oldest friends, eh<FH> Still, they're the ones who are always there when you need them<FG>
Sir<FG> I've finished my hundred press-ups, sir<FG> What's next, sir<FG><FH>
You've got guts, maggot<FG> (slurp) Slime to step things up a gear<FG> Alright, give me...
What's this, Healix<FH> Are you playing the drill sergeant for Ruff<FH>
Careful. It's all fun and games until someone gets hurt. Be nice to your new friend, won't you<FH>
Of course<FG> Err, I mean, affirmative<FG> Alright, Private Ruff, look lively<FG> Give me a hundred laps of the square, on the double<FG>
AOOO<FG> Sir, yes sir<FG>
I suppose at least the real drill sergeant would have made him do a thousand... When did those two start getting on so well, anyway<FH>
I don't know, but I hope Ruff can keep up<FG> Hee hee<FG>
You proved in Harba and Dunisia that you know much of battle, my young scholars, but tell me<MV>what do you know of the prophecy<FH>
To tell you the truth, I come from a famous family too. My ancestor was one of High King Unos's most trusted mages.
I wish I could join you in fighting Fractos and putting an end to my forefather's unfinished business, but these old bones aren't up to it.
But there's one thing I can do... There's a secret spell that's been passed down through my family that might be of use to you.
It's an ancient incantation that turns day to night and night to day. If ever you want me to cast it for you, just say the word.
The prophecy<FH> The one written on the cathedral window, you mean<FH>
The very same.
‘Should ever wicked war resume,\nA dragon shall the sun consume,\nAnd sibling souls be born as once before...
‘But till the land be steeped in blood,\nMay sovereign twins, however good,\nNe'er hope to rule in peace forever more.’
Ho ho ho<FG> Now night is day, and day is night<FG> If you ever want me to cast the spell again, just say the word.
It both reminds us of our vow never to make war again, and of the sins of our ancestors.
You see, a thousand years ago, our world was ruled by two great kings. They were brothers<MV>twins, no less.
But a great war broke out<MV>the War of Kings. Both brothers perished, and the world was divided into the Seven Realms we know today.
The prophecy is a message from our ancestors. It warns us never to repeat the mistakes of those dark times.
And it is also a reminder of the two great rulers who ushered in an age of glory...and then plunged their world into war...
So they call it a prophecy, but...it's not actually telling the future<FH> It's...actually a warning...or something<FH>
